criteria.requirement: Add pptx.layout.align_shapes/distribute_shapes for unique same-parent nonrotated axis-aligned shapes. Align left/right/top/bottom/centers to collective bounding box, centers floor to EMU integer. Distribution stable by position, preserve outermost edges, subtract actual unequal sizes and use rational gaps with nearest-even integer rounding, reject negative available gap. Validate full batch before mutation and rollback coordinate setter failure; preserve dimensions, shape IDs/Z order/content/relationships and input order return. Reject cross-space/rotated cases rather than claiming visual bounding boxes; saved geometry/reopen proof.
